snippet.title: TO-KAY: Thailand Quest | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A little gecko. His grandfather’s compass. A journey in search of the Legendary Fruit.

Watch the official trailer for TO-KAY: Thailand Quest, a tropical platform adventure through Thailand. Run, jump, swing on vines and discover tropical coasts, jungle trails and hidden routes with one-tap controls.

Explore the game and find the latest store links:
https://to-kay.com/

The song is in Thai. Turn on subtitles for the story in your language.

#TOKAY #Platformer #IndieGame
